rows.label: tlk70000024_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo-mo~! That Veronica lady makes
Ryuuryuu and the others work like pack
animals, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Because of her, we don't have any time
to play or cause mischief, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_03_msg0003
rows.name:
...But when we work here, all sorts of
people keep thanking us, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_03_msg0004
rows.name:
No matter how amazing our pranks were,
no one had ever thanked us before, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_03_msg0005
rows.name:
That part does make Ryuuryuu a little
happy, mo...
